papers.title: Scaling high and wide: How firms leverage AI and organizational design to overcome the scale‐scope trade‐off
papers.abstract: The trade‐off between scale and scope has long posed a strategic dilemma, especially in digital settings, where specialization enables hyperscaling. Drawing on a longitudinal case study of ByteDance, we theorize how digital firms can overcome this constraint through the use of artificial intelligence (AI) combined with an adaptive organizational design. AI evolves and improves through self‐learning and cross‐fertilization across domains, becoming increasingly valuable as learning accumulates. This, however, is contingent on access to structurally related data that allow learning to transfer across domains. We show how AI reverses the conventional logic of the resource‐based view: rather than valuable resources enabling diversification, diversification amplifies the value of resources. AI thus transforms the scale‐scope nexus from being a trade‐off into a source of strategic advantage.
papers.summary_ja: AIと適応的組織設計を組み合わせることで、スケールとスコープのトレードオフを克服できることをByteDanceの縦断ケーススタディで実証。AIが多角化を通じて資源価値を増幅させるという逆説的な戦略ロジックを提示した。

papers.title: Navigating digital servitization in manufacturing SMEs through value propositions
papers.abstract: The purpose of this study is to understand how manufacturing small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) can navigate digital servitization to cocreate value propositions. The present exploratory study interviewed managers from 18 manufacturing SMEs. The study identified three dimensions of digital servitization that manufacturing SMEs must undergo to transition to digital servitization and create value: (1) value-driven digitalization, (2) workforce-driven digitalization and (3) collaborative-driven digitalization. In these dimensions, entangled drivers and challenges related to customer demand, investments, employees and service platform providers must be addressed. A conceptual framework was developed for how manufacturing SMEs can navigate digital servitization and create value propositions.
papers.summary_ja: 製造業SME 18社へのインタビューから、デジタルサービタイゼーションへの移行には「価値主導・人材主導・協働主導」の3次元の価値提案共創が鍵であることを示した実証研究。

papers.title: Scenario-based sociotechnical envisioning (SSE): an approach to enhance systemic risk assessments
papers.abstract: Regulators and policy makers around the world have endorsed risk-based approaches for governing the challenges and opportunities from Artificial Intelligence (AI). However, as an anticipatory decision-making tool, the success and legitimacy of risk-based regulatory approaches depend critically on methods that help policymakers and societal stakeholders anticipate how AI may impact a diverse citizenry, the many different ways in which technological change may unfold, and the factors that lead to desirable and less desirable visions of the future. We propose Scenario-Based Sociotechnical Envisioning (SSE) as a concrete empirical approach to make assessments more inclusive, more aware of the socio-technical context in which AI systems are deployed, and more prospective in terms of identifying impacts before they occur.
papers.summary_ja: 既存のAIリスクアセスメント手法の限界（包括性の欠如・文脈感度不足・先見性の欠如）を克服するため、シナリオベースの社会技術的想起（SSE）という実践的手法を提案。AIの多様な社会的影響を先読みするための具体的ガイドブックも提供。

papers.title: Driving frugal and business model innovation: How different organizational capabilities contribute to business competitiveness
papers.summary_ja: フルーガルイノベーション（倹約的革新）とビジネスモデルイノベーションを同時に推進するための組織能力の違いを実証的に分析し、それらが企業競争力に与える貢献メカニズムを示した。

papers.title: Value-in-context for digital servitization
papers.abstract: Digital servitization (DS) is transforming value creation and appropriation for manufacturing firms. However, existing research predominantly focuses on dyadic relationships, overlooking possible dynamic, multi-actor interactions that shape servitization outcomes. This paper introduces the concept of DS value-in-context (DS-ViC) as a theory-driven explanation of how value aggregates and evolves across actors, governance structures and technological settings in digital servitization. DS value is not static but dynamically shaped by two spatio-temporal mechanisms: contextual value aggregation (spatial expansion across multiple actor settings) and contextual value evolution (longer-term transformation of governance structures, actor roles and business models). The DS-ViC taxonomy comprises four forms of value contextualization: lateral, horizontal, vertical and intermediary contextualization.
papers.summary_ja: デジタルサービタイゼーションにおける「value-in-context（文脈的価値）」概念を提唱し、空間的拡張と時間的進化の2メカニズムから4種の価値文脈化タクソノミーを提示した。

papers.title: Beyond the Creativity Paradox: A Theory-informed Framework for Role-based Integration of Generative AI in Organisational Creativity
papers.abstract: Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) is reshaping organisational creativity by emulating cognitive processes traditionally associated with human innovation. This study revisits foundational creativity theories to develop a framework for integrating GenAI into creative workflows. Drawing on structural parallels between GenAI architectures and human cognition, the paper repositions GenAI as a cognitive collaborator rather than merely a productivity tool. A role-based integration model aligns GenAI capabilities with key creative functions: idea generation, synthesis, strategic framing, and facilitation. The framework also addresses emerging tensions captured in the Creativity Paradox, whereby GenAI may weaken intrinsic motivation, conceptual risk-taking, and evaluative depth.
papers.summary_ja: GenAIを「生産性ツール」ではなく「認知的協働者」として再定義し、アイデア生成・統合・戦略的フレーミング・ファシリテーションの4機能に対応した役割ベースの統合フレームワークを提案。GenAIが内発的動機を弱める「創造性パラドックス」も概念化した。

papers.title: Fast learning and sustained exploration: The role of timely performance feedback
papers.abstract: How should organizations manage learning dynamics? Strategy theories suggest more-is-better: fast, frictionless sharing enhances performance. While organizational learning theory warns that less-is-more, as fast learning causes premature convergence. We reconcile this tension by showing that the less-is-more prediction depends critically on a key assumption: that information about agents' performance is not continuously updated. When performance information is timely, fast learning enhances exploration. The mechanism is Target Diversity: fast learning allows many individuals to rapidly reach the performance frontier, increasing the set of imitation targets. Organizations thus learn from a diverse, shifting set of targets.
papers.summary_ja: 「速い学習は探索を阻害する」という通説を覆し、タイムリーなパフォーマンスフィードバックが「ターゲット多様性」メカニズムを通じて速い学習と継続的探索を両立させることを示した計算論的研究。

papers.title: Future design capabilities at the edge of a liveable planet
papers.abstract: In the face of the transformation needs in societies due to environmental crisis, design capabilities require renewal. These have been iterated and examined together with design educators and sustainable design professionals through co-design and a variety of methods when developing two educational sustainable design programs aimed at professional designers. The resulting requirements for strategic sustainability capabilities in design include systems thinking, analysing and designing around leverage points for emergent systems change. Strategic foresight with scenario building generates visions for desirable futures. New aspects of human-driven design need to be adapted, including the regenerative and appreciative concern in human-nature relationships and design for sustainable behaviour change.
papers.summary_ja: サステナブルデザインの専門家・教育者との共創を通じて、環境危機対応に必要なデザイン能力4群（システム思考・戦略的フォーサイト・再生デザイン・場所ベース協働）を特定した。

papers.title: Technology-enabled social innovations for enhancing emerging countries' rural healthcare ecosystem: A grounded theory approach
papers.abstract: Technology-enabled social innovation (SI) is a distinct phenomenon to address grand challenges that manifest through institutional voids. A technology-enabled SI ecosystem framework illustrates collaboration for social value co-creation beyond economic value. Digital technologies enable SI complementarity, reconfiguring void-filling strategies for ecosystems' social value co-creation.
papers.summary_ja: 新興国農村部の医療エコシステムにおけるテクノロジー主導型社会イノベーションを、グラウンデッドセオリーで解明。制度的空白を補う形での社会的価値共創のエコシステムフレームワークを提示した。

papers.title: Full steam astern? Sustainable retro-innovation in the maritime shipping sector
papers.abstract: In light of the climate crisis and current challenges associated with decarbonizing the maritime shipping industry, some actors turn their attention backwards in time and promote the reemergence of sail cargo ships. A shift towards sustainable shipping could therefore be approached as a matter of revival through retro-innovation. This paper introduces a novel conceptualization of sustainable retro-innovations with a specific focus on retro-innovation tactics. Based on empirical exploration of nine sail cargo initiatives, the paper examines how actors employ specific tactics throughout four retro-innovation processes (reflexivity, reminiscence, revival, reconfiguration), and the implications for the emergence of retro-innovative socio-technical configurations.
papers.summary_ja: 海運業の脱炭素化において帆船技術を現代に復活させる「サステナブル・レトロイノベーション」概念を提唱し、9つのセールカーゴ事業分析から「主流模倣」と「急進的対抗」の2戦略と4プロセスを特定した。
